# FTIGutzwillerProjectionFromDecoupledStates

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FTI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FTI/FTIGutzwillerProjectionFromDecoupledStates`

```text
FTIGutzwillerProjectionFromDecoupledStates, version 0.01

Usage: FTIGutzwillerProjectionFromDecoupledStates [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -1, --input-file1 : name of the first decoulped state
    -2, --input-file2 : name of the second decoulped state
    --file-list : two column file describing a list to states that have to be projected
    --disable-weightcutoff : do not discard the projected state has its square norm below machine accuracy

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (while happen .x.vec at the end of each stored vector)
    --disable-gutzwillerbasis : do not express the projected wave function in the Gutzwiller reduced Hilbert space but the full SU(2) basis
    --unnormalized : store the Gutzwiller projected states without normalizing them

tools options:

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
